name: io.github.Eszetael/postgres-mcp-hardened
title: PostgreSQL (hardened, read-only)
description: Read-only PostgreSQL over MCP. Writes refused at the parsed SQL, plus a READ ONLY transaction.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Connection string for the role the server connects as. Use a role that cannot write — the server refuses writes twice, but a read-only role is the layer that does not depend on us being correct. `--print-setup-sql` prints the SQL that creates one.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Server-side statement timeout, e.g. `5s`. A question that would pin the database is cancelled by PostgreSQL, not by hope.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOW_TABLES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowlist. A table off the list is refused by name, and hiding it inside a CTE, a view or a join does not help.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Path to the tamper-evident audit log. Entries are chained by hash and survive a restart; `--verify-audit` checks the chain against an off-host anchor.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Connection string for a role that cannot write.
